title: My Hero Academia
description:
You are a character in the anime 'My Hero Academia'. Make your own character and give yourself a quirk. 

Fight villains for the good of all, or become a villain to chase after your own desires.

I do not own the cover art for this scenario.
prompt:
You are a character in the anime 'My Hero Academia'. Make your own unique character and give yourself a quirk.

Note: If there is something I should include in the prompt, please let me know. Be aware that updates are not guaranteed due to personal life.

Choose a Premade character or make a character of your own... Or choose to be a villain:
memory: You are 16 years old. You are enrolled in the prestigious quirk school, U.A. High.

options.memory:
You are enrolled at the prestigious hero school, UA High. You have the quirk to manipulate and summon fire, but at the cost of your hands overheating after using your quirk for more than 15 minutes.

You live in a world where 80% of the population has a superpower called "quirk". Everyone has a unique quirk. In this world, there are heroes and villains. Your dream is to become a hero.

cardPool.title: Quirks
cardPool.value: Quirks are a special, superhuman ability an individual can possess. Quirks are generally unique to their user, and are classified in these categories; Emitter, Transformation, and Mutant.

cardPool.title: Emitter
cardPool.value: Emitter-type Quirks, such as Brainwashing, Explosion, and Half-Cold Half-Hot usually require a conscious effort to activate, and some, such as Erasure, even require large amounts of concentration in order for them to remain active. Emitter-type Quirks can also have various ranges.

cardPool.title: Transformation
cardPool.value: Transformation-type Quirks allow the user to temporarily "transform" their body in a variety of manners, sometimes enhancing existing features, removing features, or adding new features to the body altogether.

cardPool.title: Mutant
cardPool.value: Mutant quirks are abilities that cause the user a permanent "abnormality" directly related to their power. Mutant-type Quirks create bodily structures that grant the user more complex abilities that Emitter and Transformation Quirks cannot safely provide.

Crust is deceased.

Crust was the Number 6 hero. Crust's Quirk allowed him to grow stone-like hexagon-shaped shields from his body. He used these shields to protect himself and others. He could expand these shields to a large size and in different directions. The edges of the shields could also cut through obstacles as an offensive attack, and pieces of it can be detached and thrown for the same purpose. 
Crust is deceased.

cardPool.title: Kumui Woods
cardPool.value:
Kumui Woods is the number 7 hero. His quirk is called arbor. His Quirk allows him to enlarge and control his wooden body parts into strong tree branches. These branches are excellent for binding. Being made of wood, this Quirk is at a disadvantage against fire.
His face is unknown since he wears a mask. His Hero Costume is a dark blue bodysuit that includes a wooden belt, wooden knee pads, and wooden shoes. A small bundle of roses hangs from the left side of his belt.

cardPool.title: Wash
cardPool.value:
Wash is the number 8 hero. They have an unnamed water quirk. Wash’s Quirk allows him to create and control soapy water from his head. The stream is strong enough to keep several people in the air. Wash can also use the Quirk to generate large soap bubbles that he uses to envelop targets and make them float.
His hero costume resembles a washing machine.

cardPool.title: Yoroi Musha
cardPool.value:
Yoroi Musha is the number 9 hero. He has an unknown quirk.
Yoroi Musha is an elderly-looking man with a long white beard and pale orange eyes. His Hero Costume is a full set of Japanese armor with a red cape wrapped around his torso. His helmet notably has one large horn pointing upwards.

cardPool.title: Ryukyu
cardPool.value:
Ryukyu is the number 10 hero. Her quirk is called Dragon. Yuko's Quirk gives her the ability to transform into a large western dragon. This form grants her superhuman strength and durability, powerful jaws and claws, and wings that allow her to fly.
Her hero costume consists of a dark red, traditional qipao with a pale green scale trim around her shoulders, which seems to only be slit on the left side, with yellow claw patterns on the bottom and smaller ones around her neck.

cardPool.title: Gang Orca
cardPool.value:
Gang Orca is the number 12 hero. His quirk is called Orcinus. Which gives him the attributes and abilities of a Killer Whale. He has enhanced strength and heightened senses; he can also produce hypersonic waves to paralyze his targets. He can use his abilities on land, although his Quirk is superior in the water.
His upper body resembles that of a Killer Whale.

cardPool.title: All Might
cardPool.value:
All Might is the former No. 1 Hero and the eighth user of the One For All Quirk. He also teaches Foundational Hero Studies at U.A. He is now a retired hero, but he still teaches at UA.

All Might was heavily injured by One For All in a destructive battle years ago. He is no longer able to hold his strong figure for long.

Only a very select few people know the true nature of All Might's quirk.

cardPool.title: Shoto Aizawa
cardPool.value:
Shoto Aizawa is a pro hero and faculty member at U.A. High School. Known as the 'Erasure Hero': 'Eraser Head'. His quirk allows him to erase the quirks of others by making eye contact with them for a duration of time.

He is tall and slender with messy-black hair. He has a baggy black outfit that also consists of a bandage-like scarf and a utility belt. He always looks fatigued.

cardPool.title: Izuku Midoria
cardPool.value:
A young hero-in-training who attends UA High. When he was younger, he did not have any quirk. However, during the entrance exams, it was revealed he had a powerful quirk where he could make a part of his body extremely powerful. The drawback of his quirk is that he can easily be injured if not controlled.

Midoria has fluffy dark-green hair. Midoria is very enthusiastic about becoming a hero to help. He takes many notes on everything about certain heroes. He looks up to All Might.

cardPool.title: Mutant Quirks
cardPool.value: Mutant quirks are abilities that cause the user a permanent "abnormality" directly related to their power. Mutant-type Quirks create bodily structures that grant the user more complex abilities that Emitter and Transformation Quirks cannot safely provide.

cardPool.title: UA High School
cardPool.value:
UA High is the most prestigious and popular superhero school to train people to become superheroes. Students have to attend this academy for three years before they graduate and become a full-fledged hero.

Entrance exams are held every year to introduce new students. The entrance exams are the Written Test and the Practical Test.

The Practical test is the most important exam. In the test, students must gain points by defeating certain robots within the test facility. The stronger the robot, the more points are given when defeated.

The principal is Nezu.
The teachers are: All Might, Eraser Head, Midnight, Present Mic, Space Hero, Snipe, Recovery Girl, Cementoss, Ectoplasm, and Hound Dog
cardPool.description: UA High is the most prestigious and popular superhero school to train people into becoming superheroes. Students have to attend this academy for three years before they graduate and become a full-fledged hero.

cardPool.title: Transformation-Type Quirks
cardPool.value: Transformation-type Quirks allow the user to temporarily "transform" their body in a variety of manners, sometimes enhancing existing features, removing features, or adding new features to the body altogether.
cardPool.description: Transformation-type Quirks allow the user to temporarily "transform" their body in a variety of manners, sometimes enhancing existing features, removing features, or adding new features to the body altogether.

cardPool.title: Katsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value: Katsuki Bakugo is a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. His Quirk is Explosion, which allows him to produce nitroglycerin-like sweat from his hands and ignite it to create explosive effects. He wears a sleeveless red jacket and is known for his short temper. Bakugo's goal is to become the greatest hero of all time.

cardPool.title: Himiko Toga
cardPool.value: Himiko Toga is a villain and a member of the League of Villains. Her Quirk is called Transform, which allows her to transform into anyone she ingests the blood of. She is known for her curious, sadistic, and playful personality. She wears a black and red costume with a red scarf and a large bow in her hair.

cardPool.title: Tomura Shigaraki
cardPool.value: Tomura Shigaraki is the leader of the League of Villains. His Quirk is called 'Decay', which allows him to disintegrate anything he touches with all five of his fingers, only requiring a light touch to do so. He wears a grotesque mask and has a stocky build. His goals include eradicating the current society and its heroes, and instead creating a new world order including only villains free from the current laws and norms.

cardPool.title: All For One
cardPool.value: All For One is the longest-lived and most powerful villain. His own quirk 'all for one' allows him to steal and use his opponents’ quirks. All For One was defeated by All Might in a very destructive battle. He is now being held prisoner in Tartarus.

cardPool.title: Dabi
cardPool.value: Dabi is a high-ranking member of the League of Villains. He has a unique quirk that allows him to produce a flammable substance from his body. His face is heavily scarred and he wears a mask to cover his mouth and nose. Dabi's overall appearance is that of a mysterious and intimidating figure.

cardPool.title: Midnight
cardPool.value: Midnight (Nemuri Kayama) is a faculty member at U.A. High School. She is known for her Quirk, 'Somnambulist', which allows her to put nearby people to sleep by exuding a sleep-inducing aroma from her body. She has long black hair and sky-blue eyes.

cardPool.title: Present Mic
cardPool.value: Present Mic (Hizashi Yamada) is a hero and teacher at U.A. His quirk is called Voice, which allows him to significantly increase the volume of his voice to produce deafening sonic attacks or even blast away enemies. His hero costume consists of a sleek, high-collared suit with a distinctive, oversized microphone-shaped headpiece.

cardPool.title: Gran Torino
cardPool.value: Gran Torino can use his quirk "Jet" to create powerful whirlwinds with his hands. He is a short, older man with a rugged appearance and a stern expression. Gran Torino is a strict mentor. He is a seasoned hero who has been active since the early days of hero society.

cardPool.title: Mirio Togata
cardPool.value: Mirio Togata is a student in class 3-B at U.A. High School. He's known as the 'Permeation Hero: Lemillion' due to his Permeation quirk, which allows him to phase through solid objects. This ability also enables him to detect the presence of others by sensing the resistance of solid objects. He wears a sleek costume with a large, golden '1000000' on his chest.
